row.notes: TrackSpace XML loader (vt slot 0x145bf1500, 5282 decomp lines): three XML readers: volumes from the reader at TS+0x80 (root Trackspace -> VolumeList -> Volume -> Gates/Gate point1..point4), splines from the reader embedded at [ctx+0x18]+0x28 (root rootnode: TrackSpaceSpline, AiSpline) and markup from TS+0x88 (TrackspaceMarkup -> MarkupList -> MarkupElement: Name, SplineName, Start/End, Attributes/Attribute Type; sector_1..3 and pit are markup type or spline names; property keys include focuscar_name, carbehind_name, woosh_type, template_name, chance_blowout, radius_modifier, cull_distance, transition_duration, screen_culling). Logs TRACKSPACE 'Loading TrackSpace Markup Element: %s (%s)', 'Volume type "%s" is invalid!', 'Volume remap overlap detected at dist %f...', 'Recalculating volume length: oldLength %f, newLength %f...'. Track modding: the parser that reads the TrackSpace data a custom track ships. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner re-career-teams (independent agree V2317) | 2026-11-17 engine-re track runtime round 2, static. Gate points: <Gate> point4..point1 are read in that order into slots 0..3 (each 'x,y,z'), up to two <Gate> per <Gates> element and one Game_TrackSpace_AddVolumeFromGates call per <Gates> (0x1445ec55b; 3 strip volumes each, split above 100 m). After all volumes: grid sized by Game_TrackSpaceGrid_Init_Thunk and filled by Game_TrackSpaceGrid_InsertVolume. TrackSpaceSpline and AiSpline both go to Game_TrackSpace_ReadSplineKnots; the 4 route splines are finalised with closed hard-coded (main 1, pit 0). raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested) TrackspaceMarkup part (engine-re track RE round B 2026-11-17, static): per MarkupElement it reads Start/End (floats, default 0), SplineName and each Attributes/Attribute Type. Type is matched as a whole string, case-insensitively (_stricmp 0x14534d918), against the 49 names of k_Game_TrackMarkup_TypeNames (table 0x145bf2b30, Game_TrackMarkup_GetTypeName); 'sector_1'/'sector_2'/'sector_3' go to Game_TrackMarkup_AddSector_Thunk; any other unknown Type logs TRACKSPACE 'Unknown property type: %hs' and the attribute is skipped (no crash). A switch on the type id allocates the item (0x18, 0x20, 0x28, 0x70, 0xc8, 0xd0, 0x120 or 0x180 bytes, the last for visually_impaired_turn_assist at 0x1445edd0d; vtables 0x145bf1af0..0x145bf23d0), reads its properties (Game_TrackMarkup_ReadProperties_Thunk directly, from 10 call sites, for ids 1, 3, 7, 9-11, 14, 21-24, 27, 28, 30, 36, 37, 46 and 47; Game_TrackMarkup_ParseZoneIdType 0x1445f8530, which calls it in turn, for drs_det, drs_act and x_mode; own readers for ids 2, 5, 6, 8, 35, 44 and 45; none for the 20 plain 0x18-byte types with vtable 0x145bf23d0) and checks it (vtable slot 2 at 0x1445ee102 for drs_det, drs_act, x_mode and ids 7-11, 14, 21-24, 27, 28, 30, 36 and 37; inline checks for the others; none for plain items); items that fail (ai_hint without a known template_name, aud_env_zone / spch_vo_trig with empty names, ...) are freed. Plain 'sector' (id 0) has no case and is dropped. Kept items get +0x10 Start and +0x14 End clamped to 0..1 (0x1445ee37d..); End == 0 with Start != 0 becomes End = 1.0 (wrap to the lap end); +0xc = spline byte of the container (+0x40). Each item is appended to the container's all-items vector (+0x28) and to the per-type vector: arr = [container+8], begin at arr + id*0x20 + 8 (count bound container+0x10) (skipped if id >= the type count). There is no limit on the number of items per type and no duplicate-ID check here. | re-bindings 2026-11-18: corrected the reader layout, the case-insensitive type match, the item sizes and which types read properties and get the slot 2 check, from the blind partial V20013. | re-bindings 2026-11-18: the property readers per type, the gate grouping and the spline reader from the blind partial V20018.
